{{Quote|I'm a cab driver, pal. I hear stories like that all the time.|Igno replies to Fives's claims of conspiracy|<ref name="Ord" />}}
'''Jay Igno''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] who worked as a [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] [[Pilot/Legends|driver]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At one stage during the war he gave a ride to [[Fives/Legends|CT-5555]], an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] known as Fives on the run from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] asked to be taken to [[79's/Legends|79's]], a clone bar which the driver knew. En route to the bar the commando told Igno there was a conspiracy against the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]; although the driver was used to such tales from his passengers. Upon reaching 79's, Fives left the taxi and didn't pay, much to Igno's annoyance.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Hey, you payin' for this ride or what?|Igno calls to Fives as he leaves|<ref name="Ord" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] Jay Igno<ref name="EPG">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/orders-episode-guide|text="Orders" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> live on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. On Coruscant, which was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Republic, Igno worked as a [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] [[Pilot/Legends|driver]], transporting beings around the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] that covered the entire planet. During the war he transported two [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] women to their desired destination in his air taxi, and after they paid him accepted a new passenger. When the passenger, an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] designated [[Fives/Legends|CT-5555]] and known by the nickname Fives, asked to be taken to the bar known as [[79's/Legends|79's]], Igno recognized the bar as one frequented by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] serving in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Realizing his passenger was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], Igno tried to make conversation with Fives and the clone ended up telling him about a conspiracy involving organic [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chips]] implanted in the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] of clone troopers. Upon reaching 79's, Igno parked outside and let Fives out of the taxi. When the clone began to walk away, the driver asked for payment, but Fives told him charge the trip to the Republic. A group of inebriated clones approached and laughed at Fives comment, arguing with Igno and then throwing bottles at his craft as he flew away.<ref name="Ord" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Ah, your mother was a droid!|Igno insults Fives|<ref name="Ord" />}}
Igno had [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown hair, with tan skin mottled with brown. He flirted with a pair of female Twi'leks he gave passage to and tried to make small talk with Fives when he took the clone to 79's. Igno dismissed Fives's claims of conspiracy as he heard such crazy stories often from his passengers. After the clone didn't pay Igno insulted him and his fellows. While driving his taxi, the Nimbanel wore a jacket and a green cap and listened to music.<ref name="Ord" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jay Igno first appeared in "[[Orders (episode)|Orders]]," the fourth episode in [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|''The Clone Wars'': The Lost Missions]], which first aired in [[2014]].<ref name="Ord" /> He was not named in the episode, but was identified in the episode guide posted on [[StarWars.com]], which also revealed the name was a reference to Reverend Jim Ignatowski, a character in the sitcom [[Wikipedia:Taxi (TV series)|Taxi]].<ref name="EPG" />
